_doc: Reward data. 'levels' are the hand-written level-up rewards; every other level uses the generation formula in sim/rewards.js (levelReward). Reward fields: rollPrices (money = that many roll prices at the level reached), freeRolls (bonus rolls, may exceed the cap), backpack (+slots, permanent), luckPct (permanent luck, multiplicative), expansion (free base expansion), gear (+gear slot), freeCap (+free-roll cap), items [{tier, tpl?}], unlock [ids shown as 'unlocked'], note.

4.note: Monsters start attacking; turrets and weapons now drop

10.note: Arena and bosses unlocked; extra gear slot
